# Isaiah Chapter 24 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 23 verses]*

*Isaiah's apocalypse; earth defiled; curse devours; joy ceased; cosmic judgment; God reigns on Zion*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** The LORD will punish the host of heaven in heaven, and the kings of the earth on the earth. This chapter isaiah's apocalypse.

*-- LOGOS*
